iWant: a record in my folder of what Squire decided and did, which I can read on my Mac
soThat: I can see what happened and why, with nothing secret written down
description: Squire's safety floor and hooks write each decision (an ask, the Squire owner's answer, the use of a yes, a refusal, a split, a connector call that ran) to a page in his folder that he can open on his Mac; it holds no secret and no message body.
title: The record of what Squire decided and did

acceptanceCriteria.description: What Squire decided and did is written to a record in the Squire owner's folder that he can read, with nothing secret in it.
acceptanceCriteria.given: Squire at work: its safety floor asks, the Squire owner answers, a yes is used, a call is refused or split, and connector calls run
acceptanceCriteria.then: It is written once to a Markdown page in workspace/pages in his folder, which only Squire's floor and hooks write, as a line holding its time, job, decision, tool and target, with no message body and no secret; he can open the page on his Mac through the page server; and when it cannot be written, the call is asked, saying it cannot be recorded.
